description: Reference tool: Get a credit union's rates, membership eligibility, and source-labelled NCUA quarterly profile: members, assets, year opened, charter, reported services, and branch locations. Eligibility annotates published criteria and never asserts that an individual is ineligible; profile facts are regulatory snapshots, not live prices. Use this when a user asks about a specific credit union. For personalized rate recommendations, use get_financing_decision instead.

slug.description: Credit union slug (URL-friendly name, e.g., "navy-federal-credit-union"). Required.

state.description: US state code (2-letter, e.g., CA, TX, NY). Required.

name: get_credit_union

all_rates.description: Every rate currently on file for this credit union, deposits and loans together.

apr.description: APR as a percent string, e.g. '6.147%'. The literal string 'not published' when the lender disclosed no APR — never quote `rate` in its place.

display_name.description: Normalized, human-readable product name for comparison across lenders.

last_updated.description: UTC timestamp when this rate was last scraped from the lender.

points.description: Discount points required for this rate, where 1 point = 1% of the loan amount.

product_name.description: The lender's own wording for the product, which may be a balance tier such as '$10,000.00+'.

rate.description: Published rate as a percent string. For deposit products this is the yield the member earns, not a borrowing cost.

best_rate.description: The single most attractive rate on file for this credit union across every product it publishes — it may be a deposit product, so check `product` before calling it a loan rate.

apr.description: APR of the best-ranked product as a percent string. The literal string 'not published' when the lender disclosed no APR — never quote `rate` in its place.

points.description: Discount points required for that rate, where 1 point = 1% of the loan amount.

product.description: Name of the product this best rate belongs to, in the lender's own wording.

rate.description: Note rate of that product as a percent string.

credit_union.description: Core identity and freshness facts for this credit union.

last_verified.description: UTC timestamp when this credit union's rates were last successfully re-scraped. Null means never successfully scraped.

name.description: Full credit union name as displayed.

state.description: Two-letter state code of the headquarters.

state_name.description: Full state name of the headquarters.

eligibility.description: Who may join this credit union, derived from its published membership criteria — guidance, not an underwriting decision.

associations.description: Associations or groups whose members qualify, often the easiest path for outsiders.

confidence.description: Confidence in this eligibility record, from 0 to 1. Values below about 0.7 should be presented as uncertain.

disclosure.description: Required caveat that eligibility is guidance from public data and the credit union makes the final decision.

eligibility_type.description: Type of charter driving membership, e.g. 'community' (geography-based), 'multi' (several qualifying paths), 'unknown'.

employers.description: Employers whose staff qualify for membership. Empty means no employer-based path was found.

evidence_url.description: Page on the credit union's site that the eligibility rules were read from; cite it when stating who can join.

extracted_at.description: UTC timestamp when the eligibility rules were first extracted.

family_membership.description: True when a family member of an existing member also qualifies.

geo_cities.description: Cities whose residents or workers qualify. Empty means eligibility is not defined at city level.

geo_counties.description: Counties whose residents or workers qualify under a community charter.

geo_states.description: States whose residents qualify. Empty means eligibility is not defined at state level.

join_path.description: The easiest documented route to membership when one is known. Null means no simple published path was found, not that none exists.

membership_fee_usd.description: One-time membership or association fee in dollars. Null means no fee was published, not that it is free.

military.description: Verified military-service membership paths, when published.

min_deposit_usd.description: Minimum share deposit in dollars required to open membership. Null means none was published.

occupations.description: Occupations that qualify for membership, e.g. teachers or first responders.

open_to_anyone.description: True when anyone can join, typically via a small association or donation. False means a specific qualification is required.

publication.description: Exact immutable active graph publication backing `rules`.

activated_at.description: UTC timestamp when this publication became serving authority.

proposal_coverage.description: Coverage of model-proposed claims on the source page. It does not assert that every real-world membership path is known.

proposal_survival.description: Verified divided by proposed claims, or null when none were proposed.

proposed_claims.description: Claims proposed from the source page.

published_rules.description: Verified rules published from those claims.

scope.description: Always source_page_model_proposals; distinguishes this metric from real-world FOM completeness.

verified_claims.description: Proposed claims that survived evidence verification.

withheld_claims.description: Claims withheld because verification did not pass.

withheld_reasons.description: Counts of withheld claims grouped by machine-readable reason.

publication_id.description: Database identifier of the active publication.

ruleset_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the complete ordered published rule set.

requirements_summary.description: One-line plain-English statement of who qualifies; the best field to quote to the user.

rules.description: Every verified rule in the exact active publication, including machine-readable conditions and evidence provenance. Unverified proposals are not included.

conditions.description: Conditions that must all hold for this membership path.

confidence.description: Confidence in this verified rule from 0 to 1.

description.description: Deterministic human-readable rendering of the rule.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim source excerpt supporting the rule.

last_confirmed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the latest confirmation.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the source evidence was observed.

rule_id.description: Stable identifier of the published rule.

source_url.description: Source page containing the supporting evidence.

verification_status.description: How far evidence and semantic verification progressed.

rules_summary.description: Deterministic counts and freshness summary of the returned verified rules; not a closed-world field-of-membership attestation.

schools.description: Schools or districts whose students, staff, or alumni qualify.

source.description: Where the eligibility record came from, e.g. 'scraped' from the credit union's own website.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the eligibility record was last refreshed.

worship_orgs.description: Congregations or religious organizations whose members qualify.

ncua_profile.description: Institution facts from the NCUA quarterly call report — regulator-filed data, independent of the scraped rates.

charterNumber.description: The credit union's NCUA charter number.

charterState.description: State that issued the charter, which can differ from where branches operate.

charterType.description: Charter code and its label, e.g. federally insured state-chartered versus federally chartered.

cycleDate.description: Quarter-end date of the NCUA call report these figures are from; they can be several months old.

designations.description: Special NCUA designations such as low-income or minority depository institution status.

financials.description: Balance-sheet size from the call report: total assets in dollars, current members, and potential members in the field of membership.

insuredSince.description: Date federal share insurance began for this institution.

locations.description: Branch footprint: total branches reported, how many are included here, and the branch records themselves.

officialName.description: Legal name as filed with NCUA, usually upper-cased and often differing from the marketing name.

services.description: Which services the institution reports offering, such as online membership applications and online loan applications.

source.description: Name of the regulatory dataset these institution facts come from.

sourceUrl.description: NCUA page the call-report data is published on.

websiteUrl.description: Website as reported to NCUA; may be stale or differ from credit_union.url.

yearOpened.description: Four-digit year the credit union was founded.

summary.description: One-sentence plain-English summary of this result, safe to quote directly to the user.

widget.description: Pre-built embeddable rendering of this credit union's rates for UI surfaces; ignore it when composing a text answer.

data.description: Rows and labels the widget renders; a restatement of the rates above, not new data.
